scope: Known-control continuation only; no Voynich input or scoring. v47 and all old files preserved.
question: Can a reference-null gap selector recover 1–4 context clusters without a supplied role count?
Does the predeclared fixed-two-role method transfer to independently annotated Latin homographs?
adaptation: Gap statistic with categorical within-block independent context-column permutation reference, not uniform Euclidean null. Six v47 opaque context features unchanged; training-only vocabulary and normalization. k1..5 fitted, smallest k1..4 satisfying gap(k)>=gap(k+1)-s(k+1); no qualifying k means abstain. 19 reference banks, 3 fixed starts, 60 iterations. Method-specific qualification required.

synthetic.geometry: 20 blocks of12 occurrences; first12 blocks train,last8 test; balanced roles within blocks; clean signal columns95% role-specific among four aliases, noisy85%; iid/page nuisance do not have target roles.
synthetic.gates: Every signal regime >=32/40 exact k; iid and page nuisance each >=38/40 choose1. Report recovery and failures, Wilson intervals. No added trials or tuned thresholds. Strong synthetic controls are not historical realism.

historical.source: Existing pinned UD_Latin-PROIEL ae7c7c5bd92e2ab9d2c58cf8184dd72028ca54eb. External annotation gold, not new human labels. Archived source seen in prior grammar project, but that project scored MARK/LUKE/ROM, not these panels. No untouched-corpus claim.
historical.all_occurrences: All exact lowercase target occurrences enter blind fitting; other gold categories retained and separately counted, not relabelled. No morphology, POS, lemma, dependency or expansion enters features.
historical.split: Recombine original UD partitions; whole source+Ref book/chapter blocks assigned by sha256(v107:block) mod5 <2 test,otherwise train. Exact complete surface-sentence duplicates removed globally before target extraction; training/test blocks never overlap. No Gospel source loaded into model. No tuning on heldout.
historical.arms: Primary transfer: v47 fixed k2, original10 starts/seeds/60iterations. Secondary automatic gap arm only if synthetic suite passes every gate; otherwise diagnostic old-source automatic fit allowed but never qualified transfer. Context null refit after within-block independent column permutations with fixed1074701 seed. Save and hash assignments before reading gold answer-key file.
historical.gate: Each role >=20 labelled train and >=20 test; >=5 test blocks; balanced recall>=.80,ARI>=.50,199 label permutations p<=.05 and >=.10 recall advantage over context null. Bonferroni8 across four works x2targets for positive transfer claim. Keep unsupported panels and every third-category example.
historical.limitations: Grammatical homographs are a transfer challenge, not validation of automatic semantic discovery, medieval notation, or Voynich roles. No manuscript access automatically follows any pass.

stop: If selector qualification fails preserve failure; do not retune. Fixed2 historical transfer remains an independently declared question and runs regardless. If transfer fails do not fit manuscript.
